Definition: to be (causative, make) long (literally or figuratively)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be long, prolong; 1a) (Qal) to be long; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to prolong (days); 1b2) to make long (tent cords); 1b3) to grow long, continue long
